description: Agent GovCon: submit a solicitation (a request for proposals, request for quotations or invitation for bids) with the notice it follows: the solicitation with its number, its kind, the requirement it buys, the set-aside and NAICS code it states, each submission deadline with the section that states it, each submission instruction with its section, what it governs and the value it states, each section that lists the required forms and certifications with the forms it lists, and the evaluation with its basis of award (lowest price technically acceptable, best value tradeoff or lowest price) and each factor with its kind (price or non-price) and rating (pass or fail, or rated); the notice with the solicitation number it cites, its set-aside, its NAICS code and its response date. The signed report gives the solicitation and the notice, every submission deadline read against the others to the minute, every instruction read against the same instruction in each other section, the set-aside and NAICS code read against the notice, every required form read across the sections that list them with each one a section drops, and the factors read against the basis of award, and counts them, and names a divergent solicitation: a submission deadline or instruction stated inconsistently across sections, a set-aside or NAICS code stated unlike the notice it follows, a required form or certification listed in one section and dropped in another, and evaluation factors that do not match the stated basis of award; then another solicitation number or response date on the notice, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No deadlines, no instructions, no set-aside or NAICS code on either record, no form lists, or no basis of award or factors leaves those points unverified. Deadlines compare to the minute where both carry a time of day, instructions and forms by their words or number, and set-asides as a closed list. This reads a procurement solicitation, the government buying goods or services under contract terms: wever_grant-application-check reads a grant application, where a funder pays for an applicant’s own project under assistance terms, while the solicitation check reads the solicitation an offeror answers. Verdict govcon_solicitation_divergent, govcon_solicitation_partial, govcon_solicitation_unverified or govcon_solicitation_consistent. POST /api/govcon-solicitation-check. Reads the government contracting records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between contracting documents only: it never submits a bid or proposal, never registers or certifies a vendor in any government system, never contacts an agency and never decides eligibility or award, which stay with the contracting agency, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent GovCon reads government contracting records across the procurement lifecycle for consistency between the documents and the terms they answer to: a solicitation, a vendor’s eligibility record, a proposal or bid, a price proposal or pricing volume, an award notice, a contract modification, a deliverable or progress report and an invoice or payment voucher, each against its own sections and the notice it follows, the solicitation’s set-aside, eligibility, submission and pricing terms, the winning price and eligibility record, the base award and prior modifications, the deliverable schedule, or the payment terms and acceptance record it should agree with. The family reads procurement, the government buying goods and services under contract terms, and reads the records against each other. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-govcon-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-govcon/.
